sandbachFocus: Sandbach United weren't in league action this weekend, instead competing in the FA Vase preliminary round against Ashby Ivanhoe. Despite a better second-half performance, The Bach fell to a narrow 1-0 defeat, with Ryman Johnson's first-half goal proving decisive. The loss came just days after their impressive 3-1 away victory at New Mills on Tuesday, where they mounted a strong comeback after going down to 10 men.
divisionWide: The league witnessed significant FA Vase activity with first qualifying round fixtures dominating the weekend. AFC Bridgnorth secured a dominant 4-1 home victory over Crewe, maintaining their unbeaten start with goals from Zazi (2), Suar and Dubz. Wolverhampton Casuals, despite their strong league form, suffered a 2-1 defeat to Eccleshall in midweek, though they bounced back impressively with a 1-0 away win at newly promoted Dawley Town courtesy of Liam Kirton's 66th-minute goal. Shawbury United claimed a thrilling 3-2 home victory over Widnes Town, with Ethan Pickford scoring twice in a five-goal thriller. Bilston Town produced a clinical 3-0 away display at Brereton Social, while AFC Bridgnorth's strong momentum continues to set the pace at the top. Notable cup exits include Eccleshall's impressive 4-0 vase demolition of Allscott Heath, New Mills' penalty shootout loss to Northwich Victoria, and Stafford Town's disappointing 3-0 vase defeat to Abbey Hulton United despite their midweek 3-2 league win over Alsager.
